title: FLA import: wire frame sound attachments (soundId → Frame.sound SoundLinkage)
description:
packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts line 582 detects f.soundId > 0 but warns and skips without populating Frame.sound.

What's already in place:
- The binary parser (flash8-binary.ts) already extracts soundId per frame (line 1712-1720); it also reads soundLoop and soundSync at fs>6 (line 1725) though those fields are currently skipped.
- The Frame model already has sound: SoundLinkage | null (types.ts line 111), with SoundLinkage = { libraryItemId, syncMode, repeatCount, effect? }.
- During import, the symbols map is built from the Contents stream (parseFla8Contents returns Fla8ContentsInfo.symbols). Sound library items are imported and assigned library IDs via their symbol index.

The gap: the mapper in flash8-import.ts doesn't match the numeric soundId from the frame to the imported SoundItem's library ID.

Implementation:
1. Build a soundIdByIndex: Map<number, string> lookup during the library-building phase in flash8-import.ts, mapping each SoundItem's FLA index to its doc library ID (analogous to how symbolIdByIndex is built for SymbolInstances).
2. In the frame loop (line 582), when f.soundId > 0, look up the library ID, determine syncMode from the binary field (if available), and set the frame's sound field via createFrame({..., sound: { libraryItemId, syncMode: 'event', repeatCount: 1 }}).
3. Where soundSync and soundLoop fields are available from the binary parse, pass them through for accurate sync/repeat.
4. Add a unit test in packages/core/src/__tests__/ that imports a fixture FLA known to have frame sounds (or construct one in-memory) and asserts the resulting Frame.sound is non-null with correct libraryItemId.

Acceptance: open a real Flash 8 FLA with frame sounds in Dash, publish as SWF, and verify the sound plays at the correct frame in Ruffle.
